consts.name: dcsPlaneGroupCount
consts.comment: the five groupings of the planes: the Prime Material, the Ethereal, the inner (elemental), the Astral, and the outer (the planes of power).

consts.name: dcsEtherealTimeRatio
consts.comment: the Deep Ethereal: 10 true rounds pass for every one subjective round - a 10-round Prime potion lasts 100 rounds; 10 days without food fasts for one day.

consts.name: dcsInnerTimeDivisor
consts.comment: the inner planes: one true round passes for every two subjective rounds - subjective effects last half as long; poison takes effect twice as quickly.

consts.name: dcsAstralTrueRounds
consts.comment: the Astral: 365,000 true rounds (about 170 true days) pass per subjective round - a thousand true years equal one subjective day.

bools.name: dcsTrueTimeConstant
bools.comment: time is a constant in the known planes: it cannot be expanded, contracted, created, or destroyed - 20 rounds in the Ethereal are 20 rounds on the Prime.

bools.name: dcsNativesUnaffected
bools.comment: natives of a plane are unaffected by its subjective effects: an Ethereal-native caster regains spells in a standard day, a visiting Prime mage in ten times that.

bools.name: dcsAstralSpellsExempt
bools.comment: spell casting on the Astral is exempt from the time differential: a sleep SPELL keeps its five-rounds-per-level duration, while a sleep POTION would last 170 true days.

bools.name: dcsCombinedSpellsBothLimited
bools.comment: spells combining types (alteration-evocations and the like) are constrained by the limitations on BOTH types - the intro's combined-spell rule.

examples.note: true time is constant across planes
